# Calibration

Intro paragraph for the procedure.

## Steps

Step 1: Warm up the sensor.
WARNING: Do not exceed 50 C.
Step 2: Record the baseline.

## Notes

NOTE: Use the secondary cable if primary fails.
CAUTION: Wear gloves.
